resolved_conflicts.explanation: A newspaper of October 22, 1933 says a lookout house was being completed; the register and the Oregon Hikers field guide date it to 1934. The story uses 1934 and mentions the 1933 report.
The register says the USFS built the cabin; the Oregon Hikers field guide says probably the CCC. Both are reported as the sources state them.

notes_for_editor: The brief's second location (west_us_lookouts 44.86429, -122.3205) was not read. The FFLOS point 44.85424, -122.31251 matches Oregon Hikers (44.85424, -122.31252), so the record point is kept. No source describes remains at the site. Used 1 WebSearch and about 6 page reads.
